name: Feudal Aggro with Raider and Healer Elephants
author: Eldritch

notes: Queue @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@an send all @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ and the @unit_tughluq/worker_elephant.webp@ on @resource/berrybush.webp@
@resource/rally.webp@ the second new @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ and build @building_economy/house.webp@ first
@resource/rally.webp@ 1 more @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ to @resource/berrybush.webp@ then @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/sheep.webp@ until age-up

Move @resource/sheep.webp@@unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ and 1 @resource/resource_gold.webp@@unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ and @resource/rally.webp@ there until 4
Build @building_military/stable.webp@ with the 4 age-up @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ then go back to @resource/berrybush.webp@
Produce 2 @unit_tughluq/elephant_raider_age2.webp@ and @resource/rally.webp@ to enemy base to deny resources
Produce 1 @unit_tughluq/healer_elephant.webp@ and send to assist your 2 @unit_tughluq/elephant_raider_age2.webp@
Once at 16 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ on @resource/resource_food.webp@ @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ and produce a @unit_tughluq/worker_elephant.webp@ if necessary

Once you have 2 @unit_tughluq/elephant_raider_age2.webp@ and 1 @unit_tughluq/healer_elephant.webp@ produce 2 more @unit_tughluq/elephant_raider_age2.webp@ an 1 more @unit_tughluq/healer_elephant.webp@
Build @building_military/archery-range.webp@ if opponent goes @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ and produce @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@

description: Feudal Aggro with Raider Elephants supported by a Healer Elephant. Super fast aggro that bullies the opponent into idling vills lest you trample them. Follow with Archers to deal with Spearmen.
